import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
def task_func(mean=123456.908, std_dev=1.2, save_plots=False):
    import os
    import tempfile
    import uuid

    if not np.isfinite(mean) or not np.isfinite(std_dev):
        raise ValueError("mean and std_dev must be finite numbers.")
    if std_dev <= 0:
        raise ValueError("std_dev must be positive.")

    rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
    sample_size = 1000
    sample = rng.normal(loc=mean, scale=std_dev, size=sample_size)

    skewness = float(stats.skew(sample, bias=False))
    kurtosis = float(stats.kurtosis(sample, fisher=False, bias=False))

    plot_paths = []

    fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    ax1.hist(sample, bins=30, density=True, alpha=0.75, color="steelblue", edgecolor="black")
    x = np.linspace(sample.min(), sample.max(), 300)
    ax1.plot(
        x,
        stats.norm.pdf(x, loc=np.mean(sample), scale=np.std(sample, ddof=1)),
        color="crimson",
        linewidth=2,
        label="Fitted normal PDF",
    )
    ax1.set_title("Histogram of Sample")
    ax1.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax1.set_ylabel("Density")
    ax1.legend()
    fig1.tight_layout()

    fig2, ax2 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
    stats.probplot(sample, dist="norm", plot=ax2)
    ax2.set_title("QQ Plot of Sample")
    fig2.tight_layout()

    if save_plots:
        output_dir = tempfile.gettempdir()
        hist_path = os.path.abspath(
            os.path.join(output_dir, f"histogram_{uuid.uuid4().hex}.png")
        )
        qq_path = os.path.abspath(
            os.path.join(output_dir, f"qqplot_{uuid.uuid4().hex}.png")
        )
        fig1.savefig(hist_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
        fig2.savefig(qq_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
        plot_paths = [hist_path, qq_path]

    plt.close(fig1)
    plt.close(fig2)

    return skewness, kurtosis, plot_paths
